content: {"phoneNote":"The typographic layout and receipt graphic work well, though the double-underlined brand name wraps awkwardly onto two lines in the header and services are listed twice.","desktopNote":"Strong typographic hierarchy and a clever receipt motif tailored to an accountant, held back mainly by repeating the services list and target audiences right below the hero.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":5,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":5,"hierarchy":5,"imagery":5,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"fixes":["Keep the header brand name on a single line on mobile by reducing its font size or dropping 'd.o.o.' from the logo mark.","Remove or consolidate the redundant 'Za koga delamo' and 'Storitve' sections, as the hero headline and receipt card already present the exact same information.","Straighten the receipt card or reduce its tilt to 1 degree so the body text inside remains crisp and easy to read."]}
